prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult woman — warm olive skin with a natural healthy glow, mid 20s, a chic black lob with soft layers,real king cobra eyes: large glossy golden-yellow irises with a razor-thin vertical slit pupil, jet black, running the full height of each eye, both eyes the same, the colour solidly saturated across the whole iris with a darker ring around its edge, a wet glassy shine on the surface of each eye, set in her ordinary human eyelids and sitting clear of the eyelid edges, a faraway, unfocused gaze drifting just past the camera, lips softly parted, a dreamy, ethereal expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with one or two small natural beauty marks, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her shoulders and collarbones are real living skin too, with visible pores, fine skin grain, faint peach-fuzz and a soft natural sheen of skin oils. Face irezumi: a traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo in bold black ink outlines with vivid colour fills covers her forehead: a rearing king cobra in jade green and gold with black-edged scales and its wide hood flared, red peonies around it, its body winding across the whole forehead from one temple to the other, its hooded head raised at the centre of the forehead above the brows; it is real tattooed skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible through the ink, the piercings, henna and stickers sit on top of the inked skin wherever they overlap, and her eyes, eyelids and lips stay bare real skin. Eyeshadow: her eyeshadow is a snake-scale makeup in golden yellow, olive green and deep black, a smooth gradient across the whole eyelid from the lash line up to the brow bone, with a sharp, narrow, upswept winged liner in a black-olive that ends in a long fine point at the outer corner and a faint shimmer of tiny scale-like glitter on the outer third of the lid; it sits on the lids as ordinary eyeshadow on her real skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible, and the eyeballs and lashes stay natural. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): the most extreme 'Russian lips' imaginable: gigantic, very tall, very plump doll-like lips, the upper lip lifted and flared high with a razor-sharp, towering cupid's bow, the lower lip enormous and pillowy, both lips with perfectly crisp, razor-sharp edges, the whole pout projecting far forward from her face so the lips are the dominant feature of her face in this frontal view; ultra-glossy pink-nude with a bright white highlight along the top of each lip, still perfectly balanced and beautiful, never duck-like, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: a soft, round 'baby face' jaw: full, plump, rounded cheeks, a short, soft, rounded jawline with no sharp angles and a small, round, slightly full chin. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her brows are bare like the Mona Lisa's: the whole brow bone is smooth, hairless skin in the same tone as her forehead, with only the soft natural curve of the brow ridge showing, her forehead high, smooth and serene. Her lips are slightly parted and a real snake's tongue slides out through the gap between them and extends far out: an extremely thin, round, smooth cord as slim as a shoelace from its base to its tips, split from the tips back almost to its base into two hair-fine, needle-sharp prongs, each as fine as a thick strand of hair, held in a narrow V in the air and hanging well past her chin down to the base of her throat, pale icy lilac, glossy and wet-looking like a real snake's tongue, the whole thin tongue clearly visible against her skin and in sharp focus. Her lips part wide enough to show two long, slender, curved venomous fangs that descend from her upper jaw on either side of the centre, ivory-white with a glossy wet sheen, each as long as her lower lip is tall and tapering to a needle-sharp point, in sharp focus beside the tongue. A single small, clear bead of venom glistens at the tip of each fang, the venom staying at the fang tips.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about twenty-two in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one straight bar across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; one small bar or ring through each eyebrow, all on the brow bone above the eyes and never on the eyelids; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the upper opening holding a gigantic multi-tier waterfall chandelier earring, a large classic round O-ring hoop in the lobe with three stacked tiers of marquise and teardrop gem drops cascading from it, each tier wider than the last, as wide as her palm and as long as her hand, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the lower opening holding one very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; two small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; two small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are punk in style: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are safety-pin shaped bars, sharp cone-spike studs and chunky chain-link rings. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. The ornate earring and the weights hang side by side from the two openings without touching or hiding each other. All the ear weights hang from the bottom of the lower iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly five separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear dull blue-grey lead a hammer head on a shortest chain, dark patinated bronze a pyramid-shaped lump on a short chain, blackened cast iron a coiled snake, a thick solid spiral of scaly body in a tight heavy coil topped by a blunt raised snake head, one dense lump of rough-cast iron on a medium chain, dull pewter-grey tin a square-sided cowbell on a long chain, dull dark brass a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a longer chain; on the right ear rough-cast matte yellow gold a barrel-shaped weight on a shortest chain, dull pewter-grey tin a cube-shaped block on a short chain, oxidized dark copper a pyramid-shaped lump on a medium chain, dark patinated bronze a ship's anchor on a long chain, dull dark brass a miniature anvil on a longer chain. On each ear the lower iron ring carries its own column of 5 weights on chains of different lengths, staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between two openings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel and chrome silver, spiked and studded, with no gemstones, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
